subject: I had 360...
author: Fenrir
body:
Actually, I had two of them. Right after the world launch I got myself a 360 from Germany (MS Poland started to sell them in my country a YEAR after world launch) and there were artifacts on the screen, like e.g. big black triangle in upper-right corner. Additionally, after about 25 minutes of using the console lines on the screen started to appear and after a couple minutes there was almost nothing but lines displayed. I sent it back and I got new one. This one was working quite good, but there was an issue as well. HDD was overheating (I could fry eggs on it) and whole console was working loud as hell (vacuum cleaner style). I sold it (with my Revenge for 360) and decied to wait for PS3.

And I must say I'm impressed by the work Sony did on PS3. It's amazing. Every single thing I've connected to the console via USB (Logitech G15 Keyboard, MX1000 Laser mouse, Wingman joystick, Nokia E50 mobile phone, pendrives) is working with it. Keyboard + mouse and you can easly browse the Internet. Games look great (MotorStorm, LAIR), movies on Blu-Ray discs are cool too. It opens most of files and has loads of features (PSN is cool). Yeah, you can talk to your friend during online play - you just need a headset. Not a special one, every single one which works with your mobie phone via Bluetooth will also work with PS3. You know, if you have enough money to buy it - do so. I have got cash only for one console and I chose PS3. Thing is that it doesn't really matter which one will you choose - PS3 or Xbox360 - cause both will deliver a lot of entertainment. It's up to you then.
